messages:
lara: Starting percent rollout for r-2026.03.23-rc5 -> 3 waves (5% each). deploy id=20260323-rc5. Will request stop/go per wave.
deploy-bot: Wave1 (5%) started -> region: eu-central. variant=r-2026.03.23-rc5. changelog: https://redwood.internal/releases/20260323-rc5
sre-amy: Quick check: p50/p95 fine; p99 embeddings path rising in eu-central after wave1 ~ jump +350ms. dashboard: https://dash/reports/6250012345
cory: I see a correlated increase in mem.used on embedding workers and an uptick in python OOM logs on a couple of hosts. tail: `OOMKilled` entries.
deploy-ci: Canary health hooks failed on embed-processor stage in eu-central: 3/30 failures. rolling pause recommended.
lara: Pause progression. Can we triage without rollback? maybe isolate embed service?
sre-amy: Ops: flip routing so embeddings route to previous variant while text gen stays on rc5? We could do a regional split. Thoughts?
ops-bot: Proposed safety action by cory: isolate-embed-to-vprev, max_wave_increment=0, pause_until=manual. Command: `/ops set-safety --id 6250012345 --isolate=embed --target=v2026-03-18`
cory: Vote: isolate + pin embed pipeline in eu-central to v2026-03-18. :thumbsup:
lara: Agree. Do that and run KV cache purge job after pin.
deploy-bot: Executing route split: embeddings -> v2026-03-18, textgen -> r-2026.03.23-rc5. Rolling config: 4 pods updated.
sre-amy: After split: p99 for embeddings dropped back to baseline, 502s decreased to 0.6%. Good signal.
deploy-ci: Note: automated rollback timer cleared for eu-central by human action.
ops-bot: Incident INC-2026-211 opened (owner: cory). Summary: memory regression in embed worker on rc5 causing transient OOMs and 502s. Mitigations: regional isolate, KV purge, add memguard.
lara: I'll update release notes ASAP: "eu-central: embeddings pinned to v2026-03-18 due to memory regression in r-2026.03.23-rc5; textgen remains on rc5. Investigating memory footprint changes in embed model."
cory: Followups: add CI mem-regression test, add preflight check for embed memory delta >10%, add canary that exercises embed pipeline separately next rollouts.
sre-amy: Recommend we continue rollouts for other regions but keep eu-central locked until fix verified.
lara: Agreed. Keeping stop/go open for 24h. Thanks everyone. Will post postmortem stub in #postmortems and link tickets.
